limitations: A retrieval hit is only a candidate and is not a claim of case-specific clinical support.
Relevant source IDs stay empty until named case-by-case clinical review is recorded.
This audit does not evaluate answer generation or claim-to-citation support.
Generated presentation views are deterministic descriptions; their text is not stored in retrieval telemetry.
All literal and generated patient candidates must centrally match the controlled presentation before evidence sufficiency is considered.
Multi-turn variants run sequentially through the production-shared bounded user-turn continuity resolver. This retrieval-only audit makes no answer-model or rescue-planner call.

Retrieval latency is measured inside the production retrieval function. For a multi-turn subject, the reported latency is the sum of attempted user-turn retrievals and excludes safety-assessment and evaluator overhead.
